content.comment_body: Since I updated my project to [product_name] [version_no], I have to re-authenticate each time I quickly access the website, even though I selected the 'user-specific website' and 'stay signed in' options. With [version_no] this issue didn't happen. Is there anything else I should check?
I've only experienced that behavior after logging out. This applies to [version_no] as well as [version_no] and [version_no].
I don’t log out; I simply close the browser.
I can only share my experience of what happens on my end. I’m not aware of any specific setting for this.
Alright, thanks anyway! Maybe it’s related to the smartphone browser.
Or perhaps it depends on which browser is used in general.

analysis.insight_summary: After updating to [product_name] [version_no], the user's expectation to remain logged into the website is not met; now, repeated authentication is required despite selecting 'stay signed in'. Other users report no such issue, suggesting the problem might be related to browser type or settings, especially on mobile devices.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipates staying signed into the website after closing and reopening the browser, as was possible in the earlier version of the software.
